title: Canyons 100M aid-station chart (metric, 2026 revision)
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The 2026 100M metric chart places Start at 0.0 km, Deadwood-1 at 18.0, Swinging Bridge at 21.7, Deadwood-2 at 25.4, Michigan Bluff at 36.4, Foresthill at 45.9, Cal 2 at 59.1, Drivers Flat at 74.0, Mammoth Bar at 86.7, Confluence at 92.7, No Hands-1 at 93.8, Cool-1 at 98.6, Coffer Dam-1 at 101.4, Coffer Dam-2 at 108.8, Cool-2 at 118.3, Browns Bar-1 at 125.0, ALT at 133.7, Browns Bar-2 at 145.9, No Hands-2 at 155.8 and the finish at 161.4 km.

The chart gives cut-offs of 18:30 at Deadwood-2, 19:45 at Michigan Bluff, 21:30 at Foresthill, 03:00 at Drivers Flat, 05:30 at Mammoth Bar, 08:00 at Cool-1, 12:00 at Cool-2, 15:30 at ALT and 23:00 Saturday at the finish.
The chart's cumulative figures are 5,499 m of gain and 6,546 m of loss, while the race page header gives 18,208 ft+ (about 5,550 m).
The chart marks drop bags at Foresthill, Cool-1 and Cool-2, and crew access at Michigan Bluff, Foresthill, Drivers Flat, Cool-1 and Cool-2.
